title: Landing takes ~30 s after leaving a project: low-priority loads queue in Chromium
description: Fabio 2026-10-12: back from MPI-623 the landing covers + crew take ~30 s. HAR Landing23: every image/media request _blocked_queueing ~16.6 s twice, fetch (High) unaffected, sockets free. Reproduced once in 7 isolated Electron runs (32 s). Holder not yet identified. Found on the way: a gallery card's promoted hover <video> is paused + detached but its src is never dropped, so leaving a project leaves the player loading (fixed here). Rest waits on Fabio's landing4 HAR (pending rows).
